About me

A developer who thinks like your customer

I started as a primary teacher who wanted better digital tools for kids. That led to Techedu.in, a set of HTML5 learning games, and Android apps like Navodaya Entrance Exam and Marathi Kids First School, each with 100K+ downloads.

Today I build websites, portals and apps for news media, coaching institutes, schools and local businesses: clean design, fast loading, easy to manage, and built to bring you enquiries.

FAQ

Questions? Answers.

How long does a website take?

A starter website is usually ready in 5–7 days. Portals and apps take 2–6 weeks depending on features.

Can I update the content myself?

Yes. Business and portal sites come with a simple admin panel, and I give you a short training session.

Do you provide domain and hosting?

Yes. I can register the domain and set up reliable hosting, or work with the hosting you already have.

Do you build Marathi websites?

Absolutely. Most of my work is in Marathi, English or both, with proper Devanagari fonts and SEO.
